decision: replace ambiguous CURRENT, STALE, UNKNOWN values with a minimal three-value model

values.CURRENT_AT_COMPANY: Reliable current evidence places the Person at the target Company.
values.NOT_CURRENT_AT_COMPANY: Reliable evidence shows the Person is not currently at the target Company. This does not by itself prove prior employment.
values.UNVERIFIED: Current relationship with the target Company could not be verified.

cross_field_rules: UNVERIFIED is used with PROBABLE or AMBIGUOUS when current relationship is not established
